verdict.rationale: IRCC is a government immigration department offering application services such as work permits, Start-up Visa, processing-time checks and status checks. It is not a developer platform, so an interactive API reference with runnable examples is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any API or developer reference that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
